limits: Complete public asset/profile staging only. No simulation observer, renderer or runtime dispatch is added.
All profile fields match the checked private projection apart from explicit asset-path substitutions.
Two textures reuse byte-identical cast transports. The existing swirls transport and new private transport both replay the same complete native triangle/UV/color data without coordinate changes.
Shared cast geometry is already adapted to scene units by its page owner. Newly loaded source geometry requires its own explicit source-to-scene conversion.
Native callbacks, height/trail frames, cylinder/linger/visibility policies, material bindings and pixels remain unbound.
